scope: Placement of a slab foundation on an accepted base together with a specifically selected local cementitious repair system. Reinforcement and formwork are outside this operation.

sources.exactLocator: CIP 31 — Ordering Ready Mixed Concrete: order 4–10% over plan dimensions and communicate mixture properties and placement method.
ownedFacts: mixture designation remains a project/purchaser fact

sources.exactLocator: CIP 11 — Curing In-Place Concrete: water, plastic sheets and liquid membrane-forming compounds are distinct methods; plastic sheet complies with ASTM C171 and is at least 4 mil (0.10 mm); liquid compounds comply with ASTM C309/C1315 and follow the manufacturer application rate.
ownedFacts: three curing branches are not interchangeable

sources.exactLocator: Product Data Sheet, March 2026: one-part fibre reinforced class R4 repair mortar; horizontal application 6–120 mm; consumption about 1.9 kg/m²/mm; 25 kg bag; 3.75–3.9 L water per bag; no bonding primer required for this selected system.
ownedFacts: selected mixing water = upper PDS value 3.9 L per 25 kg of actually mixed dry mortar
procurement rounding leaves a separately visible dry remainder
separate bonding primer is not required

sources.exactLocator: Product Data Sheet: ready-to-use water-dispersed acrylic curing compound, no dilution; coverage 5–6.5 m²/L; packages 5 L, 20 L and 200 L.
ownedFacts: product is ready to use and is not diluted

selectedPreliminaryProfile.liquidCuringProduct: Sika Antisol A, готовый к применению, без разбавления
selectedPreliminaryProfile.sheetSpecification: Плёнка полиэтиленовая для ухода по ASTM C171, толщина не менее 0,10 мм
selectedPreliminaryProfile.repairProduct: Sika MonoTop-4012, R4, фиброармированный цементный ремонтный раствор
selectedPreliminaryProfile.assumptionPolicy: Concrete mixture, slab thickness and repair geometry are object facts. Published manufacturer rates are normative profile values. The 15 km route and 10% sheet-layout factor are visible replaceable preliminary assumptions; neither is a hidden material coefficient. The default curing branch is the named ready-to-use liquid compound.
